This position reports to the Global IT Operations Manager and is a part of a tight IT Operations team with members both at our HQ in Gothenburg and other offices across the globe, with the ambition to support, challenge and develop each other on a daily basis. IT Service Owner Azure & Server Hosting About The Role We are looking for a senior IT Service Owner Azure & Server Hosting to take end-to-end ownership of our Microsoft Azure, Server Hosting, and Backup & Restore Services . This role combines hands-on technical expertise with Service Ownership . You will work with both cloud and on-premises infrastructure, ensuring that our services are secure, reliable, cost-efficient, well documented, and continuously improved. You will work closely with other Service Owners, application owners, Information Security, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and other IT specialists . Managing dependencies between services and aligning technical roadmaps and improvements will be an important part of your role. You will administer our Azure environment, including subscriptions, governance, RBAC, policies, monitoring, security and capacity. You will also provision and configure Windows and Linux virtual machines, both in Azure and on-premises. You will install and configure platform services such as Microsoft SQL Server before handing them over to application and system owners. Over time, you will keep the infrastructure secure and reliable through patching, hardening, vulnerability remediation and lifecycle management. Throughout this work, you will drive automation, standardisation and continuous improvement. You will also keep up to date with new and upcoming features in Azure and the wider hosting landscape, and judge how they could benefit our services and fit into future roadmaps. You will also look after the services that keep our environment protected and recoverable. This includes managing the full certificate lifecycle, from ownership and expiration monitoring to renewal and secure deployment. You will also own our Backup & Restore Services, including policies, retention and security. You will make sure every workload, new or existing, has the right backup and recovery protection. Together with application owners and other Service Owners, you will coordinate restore tests and disaster-recovery exercises. Cost efficiency is a key part of the role. Applying FinOps principles, you will monitor Azure consumption, utilisation and forecasts to find opportunities for rightsizing and optimisation. You will identify workloads that suit Azure Reservations and other commitment-based models, and you will manage those reservations from recommendation through to renewal. You will work closely with Finance and Procurement on budgets, forecasts and commercial commitments. In every decision, you will balance cost against performance, availability, security and resilience. Finally, you will own the service roadmaps, lifecycle plans, technical standards and risks for your services. You will coordinate changes, maintenance, incidents and dependencies with other Service Owners. You will handle incidents, problems and changes according to established IT service-management practices, and you will manage technical suppliers and escalations. You will keep the technical and operational documentation clear and up to date. You will also report on service performance, risks, costs and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. We Expect You To Have Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure administration and governance. Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux servers, virtualisation, storage, and hybrid infrastructure. Experience provisioning and configuring virtual machines and associated infrastructure. Experience installing and performing initial configuration of Microsoft SQL Server or similar platform services. Practical experience with backup, restore, and disaster recovery. Experience with infrastructure monitoring, patching, security, and lifecycle management. Experience with Azure Cost Management, resource optimisation, and Azure Reservations. Experience with certificate lifecycle management. Knowledge of scripting, automation, and preferably infrastructure-as-code. Understanding of ITIL-aligned service management. Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively with other Service Owners, technical teams, business stakeholders, and suppliers. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Nice to Have Experience or certifications in one or more of the following areas are considered an advantage: Microsoft Azure certification. ITIL Foundation or equivalent. Infrastructure-as-code and automation. Azure FinOps and cloud cost optimisation. Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure. Windows Server, Linux, virtualisation, or enterprise backup technologies. Business-critical hybrid infrastructure. Effective Azure optimisation with strong Reservation utilisation and coverage. Clear service roadmaps, ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement. Strong cooperation and alignment with other Service Owners. Increasing use of automation and standardisation to improve quality and operational efficiency. What We Offer International environment and dynamic workplace Opportunities to develop and grow professionally Modern and spacious office in Gothenburg How To Apply Please apply with your CV and cover letter as soon as possible as we are reviewing candidates continuously, but no later than January 13th.
